sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
[[Mirram]] is a perfect example of a Titan to use on [[TCG:LGS-B3|The Perfect Foe]] mission.

This [[Meso-Titan]] from down under has 1 ATK and 1 DEF. The '''Hop''' power doesn’t sound impressive, but it opens up many possibilities for you. For one, it lets Mirram move and start combats if it’s already exhausted. You can use Mirram to play an exhaust action like [[TCG:LGS-074|Expendable Help]] and then also use it to move forward and brawl with some enemy heroes. Similarly, it can move forward without exhausting. It can hop forward into a zone with a feature (like the Pyramid in the mission) and then exhaust to use that feature in the same round.

Mirram isn’t the toughest Titan, so you want to hold it in your hand and try to lull your opponent to feel secure enough to exhaust all their heroes. If your opponent exhausted all their heroes on the first round in zone 1 to play actions, Mirram could then hop all the way across the map and KO its Mirror Image on the first round.
